Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results. While the search results page clearly displayed an IMDb entry stating "He died on 5 April 1961," the agent's subsequent report claimed that David Eady died on "April 5, 2009" (referencing a 'happyhappybirthday.net' snippet which was likely a hallucination or misreading of a generic birthday site rather than the specific death date found in the authoritative IMDb result visible in the same viewport). This incorrect date (2009 instead of 1961) led to the wrong conclusion regarding who died earlier, even though the IMDb source within the search results actually contained the correct date of 1961.
